comments.value: I'm a Trusted User and I have well over 15 avatars uploaded...if you're talking about favourites, I'll agree...but not avatar uploads.
This post is about saving avatars, forgot to clarify

The user rank system is intended to be part of the avatar safety system and really shouldn't be used for any sort of tiered reward system like this. It's better to just increase the favorite avatar limit for everyone.
This is a bad idea and would make the ranks even worse.

I think it should also more for how many friends you made. This will simulate more to do nothing wrong in vrchat. If you does wrong things in vrchat and others don't like you, you cannot make friends.

It should boost up your rank. But even i am making more friends, 3 pieces is just way too low. I need at least 5 slots, it sucks harder and harder because there are pretty much nice avatars. Sure i can favorite the avatar world but that is swap to world, get avatar and then back. That will just raise server work (downloading worlds) more.

Still find it funny, avatar stealing became a feature aside from you only being able to save public avatars. kinda cut into avatar makers profits. but I don't really see why people would need more than 3 or even 1 at all. you can have well over 100 different personal avatars so why not seek the content for your own account as opposed to using stuff found in worlds?

I wouldn't base it on rank (though would accept that if no other choice). It's a game of creativity and social engagement - why would they not realize that COLLECTING AVATARS and their accoutrement is a big part of enjoyment? 

I'd personally like to see the limit set like favorites - you can have up to 32, and an option to "upgrade" for more if you're a 'collector'.
yes I think this will be a good thing favourite Avatar depending on rank

Looks like the limit was increased to 16 for everyone in the latest update (modulo server issues).

For the record, I feel that doing this based on rank is backwards, so I'm glad the devs did it across the board - visitors need favorite avatars more than anyone else, because they can't upload their own!
Id love to just see an optional setting for the limit removed and have the favorite list stored locally.

details:
What I ask is straight forward, I believe the higher your rank the more avatars you can save. This is just something I think would work nice as a system, can make tweeks to it. But at least more than 3 please.
